research_cutoff_basis: Final interaction-absence-obstruction/MANIFEST.json including separately bound review transcription erratum.
grouped_review_scope: Population count-ratio/weight invariants and scale corollary only; process and oracle assumptions remain explicit.
stable_review_scope: Conditional support/zero-flag sampling theorem, separately budgeted weights and synthetic integer-histogram witness. No data collection, exhaustive large grid search or tractability certification.
interaction_main_and_appendix_scope: Separate fixed-inventory full-curve classification and positive-support-promised finite Cauchy-panel receipts; do not transfer absence or uniform-cost claims.
absence_scope: Unbounded-count support-absence approximation-oracle obstruction and stated randomized/semidecision consequences, not a known-ceiling result or physical absence conclusion.

absence_review_erratum.effect: Corrects one missing factor u in review explanatory formula; author result and executable controls already correct.

historical_transport_scope.qualification: General difference space requires mass-zero and feasible-support intersections. Archived Proposition 6 assumes mass retention, which makes the mass-zero restriction redundant. Full support is sufficient, not necessary, for dropping the feasible-support restriction. The actual three-state application meets both sufficient conditions.
historical_transport_scope.other_limits: Fixed-price completed sign probes only; no source-to-PDF build verified; no review of all seven current proofs; inherited countermodel gets no duplicate credit.

dretske_scope: Metadata/access evidence only. Exact DOI/route and obstruction identified; chapter body remains unread and question open.
original_files: Byte-identical; generated reports outside component manifests are preserved as such, not silently added to original review coverage.
candidate_attribution: Final successor/review map in COMPONENT_AND_PRIOR_IDENTITIES.json governs the two historical candidates.
new_verification: Delivery assurance only; standalone controls plus digest and archive checks. No fresh Lean run, source reacquisition or protected repository operation.
